note: Tracked expectation for the CMS archive pipeline. expectedHeaders is the fail-closed schema contract: any difference aborts the archive. Download URLs are deliberately NOT stored here - they are resolved from the CMS metastore every run because CMS renames files each release. Archive family names (hospice, home-health) are a SEPARATE namespace from ProviderExternalIdentity.source (cms_hospice, cms_home_health); see sources[] for the mapping. Never join the two by string equality.

Required: zero or multiple matches fail the home-health source rather than silently letting HHCAHPS history stop accumulating. The observed id below is provenance only and is never used for resolution.
